The isolated word RECORD may be a noun or an instruction. Rendered as an instruction to record, without specifying the recording medium. The Nepali adds an imperative reading not established by the isolated source word RECORD. The revision removes the explicit instruction; whether the source denotes a noun or a command remains review pending.

rows.en: Equip participants to use the MHPSS Minimum Service Package to:
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई निम्न कार्यका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज प्रयोग गर्न सक्षम बनाउने:
rows.bt: Enable participants to use the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for the following tasks:

rows.ne: MHPSS का लागि पैरवी सुदृढ बनाउने।

rows.en: Design high-quality MHPSS programming and improve existing programmes
rows.ne: उच्च गुणस्तरको MHPSS कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन डिजाइन गर्ने र विद्यमान कार्यक्रमहरूमा सुधार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Design the formulation and implementation of a high-quality MHPSS program and improve existing programs.
rows.note: The translation narrows designing programming to preparing an outline. The revision restores designing as the task while retaining the exact programming glossary form and improvement of existing programmes. The back-translation changes the design task from designing high-quality MHPSS programming to explicitly designing a program's formulation and implementation.

rows.en: Effectively plan and budget for MHPSS activities
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरूका लागि प्रभावकारी रूपमा योजना तथा बजेट तयार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Prepare plans and budgets effectively for MHPSS activities.
